chunks: Who has settled us by His grace in the mansions of eternal rest, where there is no labour for us, nor does weariness come upon us.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of eternal rest in Paradise according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia supplications like those of Imam Ali (AS), describes the eternal abode of permanence (Dar al-Muqamah) as a gift of divine grace where believers are freed from both physical exhaustion (nasaq) and mental weariness (lughub). It underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the qualitative perfection of Paradise, where the soul experiences uninterrupted spiritual and physical ease, reflecting the ultimate fulfillment of human creation.
